description: Manage evroc compute resources (VMs, disks, snapshots, placement groups). Trigger on compute/domain keywords. Block on IAM/network/storage/Think.

cases.query: Create a new evroc VM named web-server in zone a with the a1a.m flavor
cases.rationale: Direct VM creation request on evroc cloud

cases.query: I need to make an evroc boot disk from ubuntu-minimal.24-04.1
Take a snapshot of my evroc disk called db-backup
Set up a spread placement group on evroc for my cluster
List all my evroc instances and show their IPs
cases.rationale: VM listing on evroc (alias for instance)

cases.query: Grant the computeOperator role to my teammate on evroc
cases.rationale: IAM role binding, not compute provisioning

cases.query: Create an evroc S3 bucket for my app backups
I need an evroc load balancer in front of my VMs
Create a VM named app-vm in zone a with a 100GB boot disk
expected_behavior: First creates the disk with evroc compute disk create
Then creates the VM referencing the disk by name
Uses --zone=a consistently for both disk and VM
Verifies with evroc compute vm get app-vm

cases.query: Attach an extra disk named data-disk to my existing VM app-vm
expected_behavior: Uses --append flag on evroc compute vm update

cases.query: Delete my evroc VM app-vm and clean up its disk too
expected_behavior: Deletes the VM first with evroc compute vm delete
Waits for VM deletion to finish
Then deletes the disk with evroc compute disk delete
Verifies disk is gone with evroc compute disk get

cases.query: Create a VM in zone b
expected_behavior: Matches the --zone flag with the subnet zone suffix
